grid.horizontal_construction: spherical tangent exponential map, mean Earth radius6371008.8m

height_datum: mean sea level approximation; source mixes heterogeneous datums; not WGS84 ellipsoidal height

rendering_vertical_reference.scope: explicit visual approximation only; preserve source MSL separately

attribution: World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL2024, CC BY4.0

population.spatial_precision: country/economy totals and non-spatial cohorts; no density raster or local resident count

limitations: Complete coarse source coverage; source gaps/boundary ambiguity remain explicit.
Center land/water/admin classification is not a per-vertex shoreline mask.
MSL-like heights lack geoid conversion; relative visual relief does not certify surveyed altitude.
No detailed roads/buildings, native terrain collision, navigation or realized population are inferred.
